catalog.text: Shimano Deore XT M8100 Rear Derailleur
catalog.description: A 12-speed mountain bike rear derailleur that moves the chain between cassette sprockets to change gears. Its clutch helps control chain movement on rough trails.
A 12-speed mountain bike cassette that provides a wide range of gears for climbing and descending. It uses Shimano Micro Spline mounting and Hyperglide Plus shifting.
A mountain bike crankset that transfers pedalling power to the chain through a direct-mount chainring, designed for lightweight cross-country and trail use.
A cable-operated 12-speed mountain bike rear derailleur for SRAM Eagle drivetrains. It shifts the chain between rear sprockets and uses a clutch to control chain movement.
A wireless electronic mountain bike rear derailleur for SRAM Eagle Transmission drivetrains. Its hangerless Full Mount design attaches around the rear axle on compatible frames.
A lightweight 12-speed mountain bike cassette with a wide gear range for climbing and descending, designed for SRAM Eagle drivetrains and XD freehub drivers.
A mountain bike dropper seatpost with 180 mm of travel. Riders can lower the saddle for descending and raise it for pedalling using a compatible remote.
A carbon mountain bike handlebar with a shaped profile designed to absorb vibration and reduce hand fatigue while maintaining steering control.
A compact trailside repair multi-tool with hex keys, a Torx key, a chain breaker and a tyre lever, designed for storage in compatible OneUp steerer or pump systems.
A spray-on bicycle cleaner that breaks down dirt and grime on frames and components before rinsing. Suitable for routine washing after muddy rides.
A tubeless mountain bike tyre sealant that helps seal punctures and maintain an airtight tyre system. Its UV-reactive dye helps locate leaks.
A bicycle drivetrain cleaner that removes grease, oil and grime from chains, cassettes, chainrings and derailleurs. It can be sprayed on or used with a chain-cleaning device.
Workshop labour charged by the hour for bicycle maintenance and repair. This is a service rather than a stocked physical product.
